author: Gene Simmons
title: 2027 Columbus Aviators season tickets now on sale - NewsBreak
text:
By Gene Simmons ,
11 hours ago
Columbus Aviators official helmet. (Photo: Chuck Cordes/Ohsfbmedia.com)
COLUMBUS, Ohio – Season tickets for the Columbus Aviators 2027 United Football League season are now available, with a season ticket package for all five home games starting under $100 at www.theufl.com/columbus-tickets .
The Aviators, led by Head Coach Ted Ginn, Jr. will return to Historic Crew Stadium for their second season in 2027, hosting five home games after recording three home victories in their inaugural campaign. Season tickets offer fans an affordable way to experience every home game and support professional football in Columbus.
In addition, for the first time, the UFL is giving early season-ticket buyers the opportunity to experience one of the league’s marquee offseason events — the UFL Draft. Fans who purchase Columbus Aviators season tickets by November 1 will be automatically entered for a chance to win a trip to St. Louis to attend the 2027 UFL Draft on November 18, 2026.
The Aviators hold the first overall pick in the draft, giving Columbus fans an opportunity to witness a milestone moment for the franchise. The draft will feature unprecedented access to the league’s head coaches, who will provide real-time war room analysis behind every pick live on NFL Network beginning at 8 p.m. ET.
In addition to the sweepstakes opportunity, Columbus Aviators Season Ticket Members will receive a range of exclusive member benefits, including:
1. Same great seat for every home game
2. Season Ticket Member gift
3. 20% merchandise discount at the online UFL Shop
4. Invitations to exclusive Season Ticket Member events
5. Ticket exchange flexibility
Ticketmaster will again serve as the UFL's Official Ticketing Partner.
Columbus fans can also meet Aviators mascot Maverick at the Nationwide Children’s Hospital Columbus Marathon Kids Run on Saturday, October 17, from 9:30-11:30 a.m. at North Bank Park, located at 311 W. Long St . in Columbus. Maverick will be on hand to help bring some Aviators spirit to the community’s young runners and their families.
Additionally, Maverick will join the Greater Columbus Sports Commission for a Read to the Final Four Kickoff pep rally at Parkmoor Elementary on October 20. The Aviators will also support community partners with interactive games and team giveaways at the Special Olympics Ohio State Flag Football Tournament at Sports Ohio in Dublin on October 24, and at Troops and Treats at the National Museum of the U.S. Air Force in Dayton on October 31.
The Columbus Aviators played a key role in the UFL’s pathway to the NFL in 2026, with nine players earning NFL training camp opportunities and three remaining on active rosters or practice squads at this stage in the NFL season. Their contributions were part of a league-wide total of 118 former UFL players who participated in NFL training camps this year, with more than 40 ultimately earning spots on active rosters or practice squads.
The UFL is building on a successful 2026 season that featured increased viewership, including numerous games surpassing one million viewers, increased overall ticket sales, and a sold-out United Bowl.
The 2027 UFL Kickoff, presented by New Era, will commence at 8pm ET on March 26 from Louisville’s Lynn Family Stadium. The game will be televised nationally on FOX as part of FOX UFL Friday.
Information about the 2027 game schedule and Aviators game promotions will be announced later.
For more information on the Columbus Aviators, visit www.theufl.com/teams/columbus .
